title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — accountant organization-member context repair
purpose: Repair the proven authorization mismatch between the intended bookkeeper model (role=GUEST + job_profile=ACCOUNTANT/EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTANT) and the generic RLS transaction fence without globally widening GUEST. This first repair slice introduces a PostgreSQL-proven organization-member transaction primitive and moves Connection Center/attestation repositories onto it while preserving their durable capability checks. Route-level GUEST admission and task repository migration remain a separate follow-up so the change cannot accidentally widen unrelated accounting endpoints.
boundaries: deriveTrustedRlsContext keeps rejecting GUEST; no global guest-role widening.

A separate organization-member transaction path requires authenticated user, session, tenant and organization and then proves ACTIVE membership with public.app_pc_crop_membership_id() inside PostgreSQL.
Connection Center reads additionally require integrations.read resolved from durable membership job_profile/delegation.
Attestation reads/writes retain integrations.read/integrations.configure and MFA checks already enforced by the repository.
No AccountingController role widening in this slice; GUEST HTTP reachability is intentionally still closed until task/route capability gates are migrated together.
No document, money, period-close, signature, provider, 1C runtime, EDO runtime, Prisma schema, migration, hosting or production mutation.
No browser-selected capability/job profile becomes authority.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredInvariants: Generic GUEST callers remain denied by withTrustedContext.
Organization-member context fails closed unless public.app_pc_crop_membership_id() returns an ACTIVE membership for current authenticated user/org.
A GUEST market-role label alone grants no connection metadata; integrations.read must be resolved from the durable membership profile/delegation.
A GUEST market-role label alone grants no integration configuration; existing integrations.configure and MFA gates remain required.
Cross-organization selection remains impossible because membership is resolved in PostgreSQL from current authenticated identity and organization.
